latest_release.name: v5.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: open imdb links without the warning page by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1517
* feat: add default subtitles vertical position setting by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1518
* Player: use the streams bucket for subtitle, audio, speed and scale state by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1521
* Player: sort subtitle tracks by origin by @DAnaeto in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1525
* Keep port and query string when opening stremio:// add-on links by @myceliation in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1522
* Settings: add 50, 100 and 200 GiB cache sizes by @DAnaeto in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1526
* Settings: Add mpv config file option by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1519
* fix: tidy update banner on mobile by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1536
* chore(deps): bump pnpm/action-setup from 6.1.0 to 6.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1543
* fix: respect safe area insets on all routes by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1544
* Details: Redesign the details page by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1504
* Discover: Redesign the preview as an island by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1529
* Rewrite MetaPreview in TypeScript and share it by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1531
* Board: Add the Spotlight hero by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1534
* Settings: Redesign the settings page by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1542
* Settings: Replace the Account entry with an account row by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1546
* Remote config prompts and experiments by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1545
* Settings: Put Account above the email in the account row by @kKaskak in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1547

## New Contributors
* @DAnaeto made their first contribution in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1525
* @myceliation made their first contribution in https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/pull/1522

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-web/compare/v5.0.0-beta.43...v5.1.0
